title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning for 5 Seconds?

scenes.headline: WHAT IF EARTH STOPPED?
scenes.caption: At the equator, the atmosphere keeps moving at 1,670 km/h.

scenes.headline: 1,670 KM/H SHOCKWAVE
scenes.caption: Oceans and air surge eastward while the crust locks still.

scenes.headline: A NEW CLIMATE MAP
scenes.caption: Even five seconds redistributes heat, tides, and sea level.
